transfer.rationale: ST3 R4a checkpoint, variant S (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run before the move; reported with this commit under the operator's 2026-10-06 instruction to finish Settings with self-verification). App-to-hook transfer of the Team Groups, Labels and board-layout cluster (1,212 range lines, 1,156 non-blank, in 23 ranges) into settings/useTeamGroupSettings.js: ONE hook (state and behavior, 16 inputs, 24 expanded, 158 returns) called right after the useDashboardAnalytics destructure and before useEpmSettings (which now takes labelSearch* from this hook's returns), plus three effects layers called at their original effect positions: the selection effect (after the modal-open effect, so the activeGroupDraftId initialization order is preserved), the search effects and the label effects, so every moved effect crosses zero unmoved effects. The plan's state layer plus behavior layer was also built and measured (87-input behavior layer; 181 lines and 83 interface names larger); one hook works because nothing outside the moved ranges reads the group state before the hook's slot. groupSaving and groupDraftError/setGroupDraftError stay in App because useJiraProjectSettings and useTeamCatalogLifecycle consume them before that slot, and testGroupsConfigConnection stays because it is a Basic-mode Jira connection test, not Team Groups. The one getter, getTeamOptions, is described in the ledger. The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 462-line scaffolding allowance. The dashboard.jsx lineCeiling stays 13043 until the slice's R5. The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
